hint.text: Mammals are warm-blooded animals with hair that feed their babies milk.

feedback.end: Orangutans are mammals living in South East Asia. They are the largest mammals living almost exclusively in trees. In the wilderness, orangutans can reach an age of over 50 years.

instruction.text: Which stages of an orangutan’s life cycle do the pictures show? Select the correct buttons.

feedback.end: On average, a female orangutan gives birth to a baby every five years. The young orangutan lives closely with its mother for the next 7 to 11 years before it is an adult orangutan. Then, the life cycle can start again.

hint.text: Mammals are warm-blooded animals with hair that feed their babies milk.

instruction.text: Select each picture of a dog’s life cycle in the correct order — starting with the first stage.

feedback.end: On average, Golden Retrievers live up to an age of 10-12 years. While they grow quite a lot and experience many internal changes, they look similar in every stage.

instruction.text: True of false? Select the correct answers about the life cycles of mammals.

atoms.a: The bodies of mammals change as they grow up. However, they look similar in every stage of their life cycle.
The life cycles of all mammals take exactly 10 years.
Some mammals’ life cycles last longer than others.
Different mammals go through similar stages while growing into adulthood.
